proposals: select p.{{id:proposals}} as id, p.name, p.solicitation_number, p.customer_organization, p.contract_type, p.contract_type__label as contract_type_label, p.status, p.status__label as status_label, p.due_date, p.estimated_value, p.template, p.ai_context, p.content, p.fit_evaluation, p.owner__label as owner_name, p.created_at from proposals p order by p.created_at desc
options: select property, api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:proposals}}' and property in ('contract_type', 'status') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
products: select p.pc_0021_id as id, p.name, p.product_category__label as category, p.description, p.specifications, p.key_features, p.compliance_standards from products p order by p.name
